title: DE120 Brentwood - Affordable Cooling Tower DE
description: Looking for affordable drift eliminators? The Brentwood DE120 are a popular choice for international projects due to lower freight costs. View the various cooling tower DE's we offer.

layout.title: DE120 Brentwood - Affordable Cooling Tower DE

paragraphs: DE120 Blade Drift Eliminator Modules use a series of sinusoidal-shaped PVC (or HPVC) blades to achieve excellent drift droplet removal by forcing the leaving air to make three distinct changes of direction. The 1.2-inch blade spacing allows for good performance at low pressure drop and cost, making the DE120 our most affordable drift eliminator.
